Both of us are devastated right now and grieving, especially my fiance as she has been having severe depression the past few weeks, so this doesn't help her at all. She got annoyed with me and told me it would help her feel better and to grieve. We argued back and forth for a bit. My fiance called me an asshole and said i have no say in the matter, which i feel as though i do because i pay the rent and bills in our apartment, money is super tight cause i am the only one working right now, and it would be my money that pays for this bird (we have separate accounts). I never mentioned we should never get a pet ever again, i just said it would be best to wait until we have time to properly mourn, and maybe when our finances improve. I want to be supportive to her cause she's feeling this pain of loss just as much, if not worse than i am, but i feel like i didnt do it right. Am i the asshole in this scenario? Thanks.
